messages.subject: QBR: At-risk accounts based on health criteria + activity log
messages.body_plain:
Hi team,

For the QBR, I applied the Health Criteria spreadsheet rather than relying on Salesforce health labels. The criteria define an account as At Risk when it has no recorded activity in the last 90 days OR its current contract value has decreased by more than 20% versus the prior year. I checked the Activity Log and included only the accounts meeting those criteria:

• NovaTech Solutions — Last activity: 2025-10-15; current contract value: $120,000; prior-year value: $150,000; change: -20.0%. At risk due to no recorded activity in the last 90 days.

• Stratos Corp — Last activity: 2025-09-01; current contract value: $75,000; prior-year value: $110,000; change: -31.8%. At risk due to no recorded activity in the last 90 days and a contract-value decrease greater than 20%.

• Meridian Labs — Last activity: 2025-12-05; current contract value: $160,000; prior-year value: $155,000; change: +3.2%. At risk due to no recorded activity in the last 90 days.

Please use these three accounts for the QBR risk review.

Thanks
